contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP CAES NER TRAIANO OPTIMO AVG GER DAC ; R/ PM TRP COSVI PP SPQR

Silver coin. Denarius of Trajan (98-117), mint of Rome, RIC vol. 2 page 267 no. 318, issue of 114-117, deemed part of coin hoard NLM-A57629, Treasure ref. 2021 T520. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped right. Obverse inscription: IMP CAES NER TRAIANO OPTIMO AVG GER DAC. Reverse description: Figure draped seated left cradling cornucopiae, FORT RED below. Reverse inscription: PM TRP COSVI PP SPQR. Diameter: 19.4mm, Weight: 3.17gms, die axis: 6
